newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar management meeting may view new figures.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar management meeting may view new figures.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee on Wednesday may get new beet sugar production estimates ahead of the expected date, an EU official said on Monday.
"A new balance sheet with the latest beet sugar production estimates is not due until the end of the month but it is rumoured that one may be ready for the committee this week," the official said.

The agenda for Wednesday's meeting is scheduled to be routine with the committee listed as deciding only the usual weekly tenders, periodic refunds for white and raw sugar in its natural state and molasses duties.
A trade source told Reuters that the industry is not expecting a new balance sheet this week. "The rumour is interesting," the source said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
